newsitem.title: UK: British Gas to sell Morecambe Bay - paper.
newsitem.headline: British Gas to sell Morecambe Bay - paper.

text.p: The Sunday Times said on Sunday British Gas Plc was likely to sell the whole of Morecambe Bay, Britain's biggest gas field, as part of its bid to resolve a row over its costly take-or-pay gas contracts.
British Gas officials were not available to comment on the Sunday Times story.
In its report, the newspaper said the field would be sold either to a single purchaser or broken up into smaller parcels.
Last week British Gas reached a deal with British Petroleum over the take-or-pay contracts which had obliged the company to buy more gas than it could sell.
Industrial analysts have said a similar deal with Mobil Corp is now also likely. In addition, British Gas has already struck a deal with its own production unit.
BP and the production unit will be paid compensation totalling 293 million pounds for giving British Gas relief in volumes and prices.
Analysts said last week that it was possible that assets rather than cash could be exchanged as part of the deals.
Although British Gas had said BP would be compensated fully in cash rather than assets, it did say Morecambe Bay was playing a role in renegotiations with some other producers.
